question: Among genetically inferred origins of 163 EOG-eligible Glanville family/destination assignments (100 target patch-years), are origin-target pairs geographically closer and more host similar than expected from recombining year-specific source-label frequencies? Is host matching still apparent among geographically distance-matched *assigned-source-roster* opportunities?
true_target: conditional nonrandom genetic assignment pairing, not selection, occupancy, true natal dispersal, or independent predictive gain

eligibility.qualifying_assignments: PatchFrom != PatchTo, YearTo=YearFrom+1, t-1 PatchFrom recorded positive and host-complete, t-1 PatchTo recorded zero and host-complete, t PatchTo recorded positive, both source and target mapped
eligibility.multiple_sources_per_target: preserve original number of assignment rows per target; treat each target/year equally when computing primary statistic
eligibility.genetic_source_assignment: GENECLASS2 previous-year sampled-reference inference (published score 100 filter), score absent in the uploaded CSV; no independent confirmation

predeclared_primary_conditional_recombin.rule: Within each YearFrom, uniformly permute the complete multiset of genetically assigned source PatchFrom labels across the 163 eligible family/destination rows; keep destination rows, within-year source-label frequencies, year-specific roster size, number of rows per target, and target host scores fixed.
predeclared_primary_conditional_recombin.reject_if: any pseudo-assignment has same PatchFrom as destination PatchTo (observed primary scope off-patch only), resample the within-year permutation; never allow self-zero routes
predeclared_primary_conditional_recombin.statistic_distance: Across 100 target patch-years: mean of within-target median log1p(projected assigned-origin distance in km)
predeclared_primary_conditional_recombin.statistic_host: Across 100 target patch-years: mean of within-target median maximum ordinal Plantago/Veronica source-target host gap, both measured at YearFrom
predeclared_primary_conditional_recombin.p_tail_direction: smaller mean log-distance or host gap than permuted origin assignment roster
predeclared_primary_conditional_recombin.primary_significance_readout: conditional permutation tail probability and difference in statistic; NOT biological sampling p-value, because assignment probability and reference availability are not known
predeclared_primary_conditional_recombin.family_clustering_caveat: Six of 163 are repeated full-sib family-destination row units; preserve rows and target aggregation but do not count iid family samples
predeclared_primary_conditional_recombin.source_frequency_control: Exact empirical count of genetically assigned origin labels among the selected 163 within each source year, NOT all possible population sources

predeclared_secondary_distance_matched_r.construction: For each eligible genetic assignment row, compare its assigned-origin host gap with original-year eligible, distinct source sites that appeared as a genetically assigned origin anywhere in all 799 rows in the same YearFrom and were recorded positive in survey. Exclude target itself. Include original assigned source.
predeclared_secondary_distance_matched_r.spatial_caliper_km: max(0.5 km, 25% of that row's assigned-source Euclidean distance)
predeclared_secondary_distance_matched_r.metric: Across target-years that have at least one row with >=3 distance-matched source sites, target-equal mean of within-target mean (assigned host gap minus opportunity-weighted mean compatible source gap).
predeclared_secondary_distance_matched_r.alternative_scope: All t-1 recorded-positive EOG sources used as a source-universe sensitivity, still distance-matched; not an independently sampled GENECLASS2 reference set
predeclared_secondary_distance_matched_r.inferential_status: descriptive matching only, no p-value or causal selection claim

reproduction_and_checks: SHA256 of uploaded genetic source and 2019 archive match frozen publishers; no coordinate unit changes
799 total, 498 offpatch, 760 distinct family IDs, 39 split, 163 target-source eligible assignment rows, 100 targets, 157 distinct families
reproduce original five year EOG source/target counts and archived 8 host/radius world counts before null scoring
within-year pseudo-origin labels preserve EXACT yearwise origin frequency, no same-patch selected, no year crossover
permutation results deterministic from seed and ordered canonical source/target keys
assigned source from previous-year positive recorded candidates, same 2019 t-1 host scores as EOG
secondary candidate sources are only previous-year positive, do not include targets as source; no inferred source directions from nearest-patch geometry
all calculations local; only 5-year aggregate and diagnostic counts exported; no patch IDs, family IDs, original rows or individual coordinate pairs
missing source support or inability to obtain 1999 valid permutations results in science STOP, not threshold tuning

claim_boundary.study_design: retrospective, genetically model-assigned origin roster conditioned on previously sampled populations; reference sampling is a source-selection confounder
